rules: H:/UltimaAI/_shared/paradigms/Codex-外部执行端调用范式.md relevant DoR, review, scope and receipt rules
strengths: The omission is demonstrated in current source: exchange records request digest, status and counters; _project does not export receipts.
The patch is limited to diagnostic projection/decoding and tests. Transport, body reads, request construction, schema/replay and acceptance gates remain outside the patch.
The plan preserves the current 8B, original budgets, zero actual/model allocations and the predecessor failure.
The final plan explicitly binds validated_response to matching generation and request hash, and binds receipt provenance to one matching timeline event.

checks.conclusion: Offline investigation and diagnostic-only implementation are within the recorded scope. No new actual case, model generation, retry, production-service operation, UI/audio work, install, model download or acceptance credit is authorized.

The source allocates zero-based receipts before admission, records send or admission_refused with generation and receipt_index, and stores status only after client.send returns. The plan now requires the exact last receipt, a unique matching event, matching send_reserved semantics, bounded timeline, allowed route triple, null/no-response cases and fail-closed capture on malformed provenance.

A 2xx transport return precedes JSON/schema/security validation in source. validated_response therefore requires a matching chat wire generation, hashes.entity and secured_envelope, plus sent/2xx/no transport error. Metadata responses, old/mismatched wires, bad JSON/schema and scan failures cannot establish that flag. The flag remains separate from factual, write, ACK and delivery acceptance.

The closed v3 projection retains exact integer checks, SHA fields, request binding, canonical JSON and packet CAP. New bounds distinguish bool from int, constrain status/route and receipt/generation/timeline counts, preserve metadata/chat byte caps, and reject unsent/body or non-2xx/admission contradictions. Corrected zero-based receipt_index is 0..23 for at most 24 receipts; present generation is 1..8.

Non-2xx raises before iter_raw in current source. Exporting only trusted scalars needs no response-body access. Existing scanning, canonical serialization, validation and freeze-once summary remain applicable; unavailable capture preserves the original failure. Late mutation and scanner failure must be covered by the planned tests.

The planned real-SDK MockTransport stream fixtures, bad JSON/schema/overflow/scanner cases, metadata variants, pre-send/null/stale provenance, forged types/caps/coherence and frozen mutation coverage address the risk surface. RED/GREEN evidence remains separate and a later independent preparation review is required. No tests were executed by this reviewer.

Saved template and pinned source support the stated think=false/JSON-schema interface investigation and do not establish native parser causality. All 7 local upstream files matched recorded size, SHA256 and computed git-blob SHA1; 4 also matched an independently recorded expected blob SHA1. The remaining provenance limits and installed-binary non-equivalence are disclosed. No new request/schema change is justified by this evidence.

resolved_review_comments.issue: The original <=24 receipt_index bound admitted an impossible 25th zero-based index.
resolved_review_comments.resolution: Planner corrected receipts<=24, receipt_index 0..23 and present generation 1..8. Verified in the final digest.

implementation_acceptance_obligations: Demonstrate receipt-derived actual status without reading a private/oversized HTTP500 stream; preserve the original Research HTTP status failure.

Demonstrate last_http null/no-response and failed send/admission paths, metadata version/tags paths, and absent/duplicate/mismatched timeline or stale/mismatched wire provenance without attributing old HTTP success to the current attempt.
Demonstrate HTTP200 JSON/schema/security failures keep validated_response false; a valid matching secured chat wire may set it true without granting completion or delivery credit.
Demonstrate exact types, all caps and coherence constraints, scanner failure, CAP failure and freeze-once behavior for new fields.
Retain immutable RED/GREEN receipts and exact source/dependency bindings, run the planned offline regressions, and obtain the separate independent preparation review.
